output.explanation: Verified against checkout ea8b12a8a9894b5259c441eadd8f6f0c65e215af. The central tree follows Surface's actual fields and lifetimes; IO/emulation, renderer internals, and external shared services are expanded separately. Workers remain Surface-owned siblings rather than children of the objects they operate on. Ownership clarifications from source: renderer.State references rather than owns Terminal and Inspector; Exec's reader/writer runtime handles reside in the IO thread's stack ThreadData; the renderer worker releases the previous font-grid reference, while Surface releases the current reference during shutdown. Surface mailboxes wrap App.mailbox rather than owning separate queues. Cross-diagram edges preserve state access, message routing, rendering, and shared-resource dependencies.

diagrams.ascii:
Surface: one terminal session (src/Surface.zig)
|
|-- Identity/state: id, focused, visible, readonly, child_exited, command_timer
|-- Lifecycle methods
|   |-- init() -> constructs IO/renderer and starts their workers
|   |-- deinit() -> stop/join search, renderer, IO; then free shared state
|   `-- close() -> rt_surface.close(needsConfirmQuit()); host destroys session
|-- app, rt_app, rt_surface: borrowed references -> external context
|-- config: DerivedConfig; config_conditional_state: ConditionalState
|   |-- Copied settings, bindings and font configuration
|   `-- updateConfig() -> replace settings; send IO/renderer config messages
|-- Font reference: font_grid_key, font_size, font_metrics, font_size_adjusted
|   `-- setFontSize() -> App.font_grid_set.ref(); send grid to renderer worker
|       `-- Worker accepts grid and derefs old key; deinit() derefs current key
|-- size: renderer.Size (screen pixels, cell metrics, padding)
|   `-- contentScaleCallback()/sizeCallback()/setCellSize() -> resize()
|       `-- -> IO resize + renderer resize; geometry determines terminal grid
|-- keyboard: Keyboard
|   |-- Sequence bindings, queued input, active key-table stack, last_trigger
|   `-- keyCallback() -> maybeHandleBinding() -> performBindingAction()
|       `-- Unconsumed keys -> encodeKey(); modes from io.terminal -> bytes
|-- pressed_key, last_binding_trigger: separate Surface fields
|-- mouse: Mouse
|   |-- Button/modifier/link state; SelectionGesture; pending scroll
|   `-- Mouse callbacks -> io.terminal selection/viewport or mouseReport()
|       `-- -> input.mouse_encode; runtime URL opening
|-- Text/IME/clipboard methods
|   |-- preeditCallback() -> renderer_state.preedit
|   |-- copySelectionToClipboards() -> runtime clipboard services
|   `-- start/complete/denyClipboardRequest(); textCallback() -> encoded input
|-- queueIo(msg): owns the outgoing message
|   |-- readonly drops PTY-write messages, not scrolling/copying/selection
|   `-- -> io.queueMessage(): transfer to IO mailbox
|-- io: termio.Termio [session IO/emulation detail]
|-- io_thread: termio.Thread; io_thr: worker handle (src/termio/Thread.zig)
|   |-- Event loop, stop signal; resize-coalescing/selection-scroll/sync timers
|   |-- threadMain(): stack CallbackData with Termio.ThreadData
|   |   `-- backend.exec runtime state: PTY writer, exit watcher, reader handle
|   `-- Drain io.mailbox -> backend writes/Termio operations; reset sync timeout
|-- renderer_state: renderer.State (src/renderer/State.zig)
|   |-- Mutex pointer (allocated/freed by Surface), demand/handoff counters
|   |-- Preedit text and render-facing mouse state
|   |-- terminal -> io.terminal; inspector -> optional owned Inspector
|   `-- lockDemand()/unlockDemand() arbitrate snapshots with busy IO parsing
|-- renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) [presentation detail]
|-- renderer_thread: renderer.Thread; renderer_thr: worker handle
|   |-- Mailbox, event loop, wakeup/draw signals, blink/animation timers
|   |-- Wakeup -> renderer.updateFrame() -> drawFrame(); visibility gates work
|   `-- Compression scheduler -> io.terminal.compress(.incremental) under lock
|-- draw() -> renderer.drawFrame(true), for host-driven synchronous drawing
|-- search: optional Surface.Search
|   |-- state: terminal.search.Thread (src/terminal/search/Thread.zig)
|   |   |-- Mailbox, refresh timer, match notification state
|   |   `-- search: optional TerminalSearch
|   |       `-- ScreenSearch/ViewportSearch; copy io.terminal data under lock
|   |-- thread: worker handle; Search.deinit() stops and joins it
|   `-- searchCallback_()
|       |-- -> renderer mailbox: viewport/selected-match highlights
|       `-- -> surface mailbox: match count and selected index
|-- inspector: optional owned Inspector (src/inspector/Inspector.zig)
|   |-- Mouse inspection + GUI state: key history and VT recording
|   |-- activate/deactivateInspector() -> shared pointer; notify IO/renderer
|   `-- recordKeyEvent() <- input events and encoded bytes
`-- surfaceMailbox()/handleMessage(): main-thread message boundary
    |-- Mailbox is a surface-addressed adapter over App.mailbox, not a new queue
    `-- -> rt_app.performAction(): title, notifications, scrollbar and UI changes

io: termio.Termio (src/termio/Termio.zig)
|
|-- backend: termio.Backend.exec (src/termio/Exec.zig)
|   |-- subprocess: Subprocess
|   |   `-- Command/environment, shell integration, child process and PTY
|   `-- threadEnter() starts child, exit watcher and PTY read worker
|       |-- Runtime handles -> IO thread's stack ThreadData.backend.exec
|       |-- PTY reader -> processOutput(bytes)
|       `-- Child exit -> Surface mailbox
|-- terminal_stream: StreamHandler.Stream (src/termio/stream_handler.zig)
|   |-- terminal.Stream parser + StreamHandler
|   |   |-- APC/DCS handlers; clipboard grants/in-flight transaction state
|   |   `-- terminal reference -> sibling terminal, not another emulator
|   `-- Handler actions -> terminal edits, IO replies, Surface messages, render wake
|-- terminal: terminal.Terminal (src/terminal/Terminal.zig)
|   |-- screens: ScreenSet (src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig)
|   |   |-- Owned primary/alternate screen slots; active is a borrowed alias
|   |   `-- Each allocated Screen (src/terminal/Screen.zig)
|   |       |-- pages: PageList -> grid and scrollback
|   |       |-- Cursor/saved cursor, selection and charset
|   |       `-- Kitty keyboard flags and image storage (when enabled)
|   |-- Modes, colors, tabstops, scrolling region, title and working directory
|   `-- Text/grid editing, screen switching, scrolling, resize and compression
|-- mailbox: termio.Mailbox; config: DerivedConfig; size
|-- Borrowed renderer_state, renderer mailbox/wakeup; Surface mailbox adapter
|-- processOutput(bytes)
|   |-- Lock renderer_state.mutex -> nextSlice() -> StreamHandler -> terminal
|   |-- Inspector active: recordPtyRead() + byte-wise next() instead
|   `-- -> Renderer wakeup; IO mailbox notification for generated replies
`-- resize()/changeConfig(): invoked by Surface's IO worker
    |-- resize(): shared mutex covers PTY resize + Terminal.resize()
    `-- -> Renderer resize message + wakeup after terminal geometry changes

renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI)
(src/renderer.zig; src/renderer/generic.zig)
|
|-- terminal_state: terminal.RenderState snapshot (not the live Terminal)
|-- font_shaper: font.Shaper; font_shaper_cache
|-- cells, image state, search matches and selected-match highlights
|-- api: GraphicsAPI (Metal or OpenGL); borrows App.device
|-- Per-surface GPU resources
|   |-- SwapChain -> buffered FrameState resources
|   `-- Shaders, uniforms, image buffers and atlas textures
|-- font_grid: borrowed SharedGrid pointer -> App.font_grid_set
|-- DerivedConfig; geometry; display link/animation state
|-- updateFrame(shared State)
|   |-- lockDemand() -> snapshot State.terminal; unlockDemand()
|   `-- Snapshot + font grid + selection/search/preedit -> cells and images
|-- drawFrame() -> Metal/OpenGL presentation
|   `-- Reads shared font atlases; synchronizes per-frame GPU textures
`-- Driven by Surface.renderer_thread, or Surface.draw() for synchronous drawing

External context: shared services and host (not Surface-owned)
|
|-- App (src/App.zig)
|   |-- surfaces: registry of runtime surface references, not layout ownership
|   |-- mailbox: main-thread queue
|   |   `-- Dispatch surface_message -> addressed Surface.handleMessage()
|   |-- font_grid_set: font.SharedGridSet (src/font/SharedGridSet.zig)
|   |   |-- Reference-counted matching font grids; shared font library/discovery
|   |   `-- SharedGrid (src/font/SharedGrid.zig)
|   |       |-- Resolver/fallback font collection; codepoint/glyph caches
|   |       `-- Metrics, color/grayscale CPU atlases and synchronization
|   `-- device: shared render device -> borrowed by per-surface GraphicsAPI
`-- apprt.runtime (src/apprt.zig; platform-selected implementation)
    |-- Native app/surface services and host-managed window/tab/split layout
    |-- Input/IME/geometry callbacks -> Surface
    |-- Clipboard and URL-opening services <- Surface requests
    |-- performAction() <- Surface UI updates
    `-- rt_surface.close(confirm) -> host close/destruction lifecycle

edges.label: Highlight copies delivered through renderer mailbox
Snapshot live Terminal; do not own it
Use shared resolver, glyph caches and atlases
